speaking.canDo: Introduce yourself and others, ask and answer simple questions about where you live, what you do and what you have, and use isolated phrases and very short sentences.
speaking.expects: Short phrases about yourself and everyday things. Answer in full sentences, even simple ones.
speaking.focus: Present simple, basic questions, numbers, everyday nouns
speaking.exams: Cambridge Pre A1 Starters and A1 Movers · Trinity GESE 1-2

writing.canDo: Write simple isolated phrases and sentences about yourself, fill in a form with personal details, and write a short simple postcard or message.
writing.expects: Short sentences about yourself and everyday things. One idea per sentence, correct spelling and capital letters.
writing.focus: Present simple, basic linking (and / but / because), spelling, punctuation
writing.exams: Cambridge Pre A1 Starters and A1 Movers · Trinity GESE 1-2

speaking.canDo: Handle short routine exchanges, describe your family, routine, immediate surroundings and past events, and cope with simple transactions such as shopping, travel and appointments.
speaking.expects: Describe your routine, past events and plans in a few linked sentences.
speaking.focus: Past and future forms, because / but / so, common collocations
speaking.exams: Cambridge A2 Key · Trinity ISE Foundation · IELTS 3.0-4.0

writing.canDo: Write short, simple notes and messages, a very simple personal letter or email, and describe everyday aspects of your life in a series of simple linked phrases.
writing.expects: Describe routine, past events and plans in a few linked sentences, and write a short informal message that gets the job done.
writing.focus: Past and future forms, paragraphing, everyday connectors, informal register
writing.exams: Cambridge A2 Key · Trinity ISE Foundation · IELTS 3.0-4.0

speaking.canDo: Deal with most situations while travelling, give a short prepared talk, explain and defend an opinion with reasons and examples, and follow the main points of an unfamiliar topic.
speaking.expects: Give and defend an opinion with reasons and examples, and handle an unfamiliar topic.
speaking.exams: Cambridge B1 Preliminary and B2 First · IELTS 4.0-6.5 · TOEFL iBT 42-94 · Trinity ISE I-II

writing.canDo: Write straightforward connected text on familiar topics, personal letters describing experiences and impressions, and short reports or essays that give reasons for and against a view.
writing.expects: Organise a text with an opening, body and close, and support an opinion with reasons and examples.
writing.focus: Topic sentences, cohesive devices, formal and informal register, opinion language
writing.exams: Cambridge B1 Preliminary and B2 First · IELTS 4.0-6.5 · TOEFL iBT 42-94 · Trinity ISE I-II

speaking.canDo: Speak fluently and spontaneously with little searching for words, argue a case precisely, concede counterarguments, and shift register between academic, professional and social settings.
speaking.expects: Argue a position precisely, concede counterarguments and adapt your register.
speaking.focus: Nominalisation, stance markers, idiomatic and academic phrasing
speaking.exams: C1 Advanced · C2 Proficiency · IELTS 7.0+ · TOEFL iBT 95+ · ECPE

writing.canDo: Express yourself in clear, well-structured text, write about complex subjects in an essay, report or letter, and adopt an appropriate register and rhetorical structure for the reader.
writing.expects: Argue a position precisely, weigh counterarguments and control register, cohesion and emphasis over a long text.
writing.focus: Nominalisation, hedging, complex syntax, rhetorical structure, academic phrasing
writing.exams: C1 Advanced · C2 Proficiency · IELTS 7.0+ · TOEFL iBT 95+ · ECPE
